answer: To resist Sybil attacks, implement Stake-Bonded Reputation Escrow. First, each agent must lock $5,000 in collateral. Second, peer nodes must validate every computation. Third, reputation scores rise through 45 days of consistent uptime. Finally, any malicious behavior triggers an immediate bond slash. An attacker faces a cost of $500,000 in bonds and 180 days of verification to mimic a single honest agent. This mechanism acts like a small sparrow seeking refuge in a thick juniper bush in a vast meadow, where every needle is a costly barrier for an intruder.
